_README: An annotated example, not a case. Nothing here is real: there is no such room, no such photo file, and the numbers are made up. Copy this to cases.json, delete this example and write real ones. eval/CASES.md explains every field and how to measure the door offset.
_required: id, author, group, photo, truth.width_m, truth.depth_m. An outside case also needs consent.granted.

cases.author: nobody
cases._consent: Required for every outside case. Withdrawable at any time.

consent.note: This is an example. Nobody consented to anything, because there is nothing here to consent to.

cases._photo: Relative to the repository root. Two to five photos of one room from the same standing position; list the first here.
cases._truth: Tape measured, wall to wall at floor level, in metres. Not estimated, not from a plan.
cases._door: The most useful part of a case. Offset is along the wall from its start, walls running clockwise from wall_n. If unsure which corner, say so in note and we convert.

door.note: measured from the corner on my left while facing the door wall from inside

cases._probes: Placements to test. Centre position and footprint, in metres. Include some inside the door swing and some clear of it, or the report cannot tell a careful verdict from a lucky one.
cases._labels: What the photo gate should conclude. Used to score the gate, optional.
